SUB RefreshEntries()
    DIM entries AS Wydgit
    DIM entry AS Wydgit
    DIM position AS Number = 0
    FOR EACH child IN Me.related("children", "blocks")
        IF child.id = "guestbook-entries" THEN
            SET entries = child
        END IF
    NEXT child
    DIM result = SERVICES.Call("wydstore", "query", {"store":"entries", "collection":"entries", "limit":20})
    FOR EACH previous IN entries.related("children", "blocks")
        previous.Remove()
    NEXT previous
    IF NOT result.ok THEN
        FOR EACH item IN Me.related("children", "blocks")
            IF item.id = "guestbook-status" THEN
                item.Set("content", {"type":"markdown", "value":"Guestbook entries are temporarily unavailable."})
            END IF
        NEXT item
        RETURN
    END IF
    FOR EACH record IN result.value
        SET entry = NEW "divdev/guestbook-entry"("guestbook-entry-" & NewId())
        CALL entry.ShowEntry(record.data.name, record.data.message)
        entries.Insert("blocks", position, entry)
        position = position + 1
    NEXT record
END SUB

FUNCTION SaveEntry() AS Boolean
    DIM values AS Object = Me.Values()
    DIM result = SERVICES.Call("wydstore", "create", {"store":"entries", "collection":"entries", "id":NewId(), "data":{"name":values.name, "message":values.message}})
    RETURN result.ok
END FUNCTION

SUB ShowEntry(name AS String, message AS String)
    Me.Set("content", {"type":"markdown", "value":name & " — " & message})
END SUB
